title: La sopa
goal: Eat sopa de mondongo and be watched while you do it
culture: Masatepe is where people drive to eat mondongo, which is tripe soup. The whole table will watch your first spoonful. Honesty is completely fine — está fuerte is accurate and acceptable — and pulling a face is the only thing that is not.

beats.objective: Ask what is in it, before
beats.good: Ask before, not after. Mondongo is tripe, and Masatepe is where people drive from other departments to eat it.

beats.es: Panza de res, yuca, chayote... ¿nunca ha comido?
beats.good: Say it. Everybody at that table wants to watch a first spoonful, and you may as well let them enjoy it.

beats.es: (Toda la mesa lo está viendo. Pruebe.)
beats.good: Está fuerte — it is strong. Honest, accurate and completely acceptable. Pulling a face is the thing that would not be.

beats.objective: Say the thing they are waiting for
beats.good: Pero me gustó — but I liked it. If it is true, this is the sentence the whole table was waiting for, and you will immediately be given more.
